deliverables.title: In-class Participation (iClicker Polls)
deliverables.notes: Graded on completion only based on percentage of questions answered throughout the semester. At least 80% answered = 5/5; 70–79% = 4/5; 60–69% = 3/5; 50–59% = 2/5; 40–49% = 1/5; <40% = 0. Dates listed as 'See OWL.'
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: No specific dates provided; ongoing throughout the semester per lecture attendance.

deliverables.title: Quizzes (best 6 of 8)
deliverables.notes: 8 quizzes total via WebWork platform; best 6 count toward final grade. Dates listed as 'See OWL.' Partially cumulative. First 2 missed quizzes do not require Academic Consideration; additional missed quizzes (3rd, 4th…) may be reweighted to the final exam.

deliverables.title: Midterm Test
deliverables.notes: In-person, closed-book, 120-minute written test (7 pm to 9 pm). Covers course material from weeks 1–6 inclusive. Mix of multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blanks, matching, and short-answer questions. No calculators, electronic devices, notes, or aids permitted. Make-up midterm tentatively scheduled for Friday, March 6 from 7 pm to 9 pm. Always requires formal supporting documentation for Academic Consideration.

deliverables.title: Final Exam
deliverables.notes: In-person, closed-book, 180-minute written exam covering all course material. Mix of multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blanks, matching, and short-answer questions. No calculators, electronic devices, notes, or aids permitted. Scheduled by the Registrar's Office during the April 12–30, 2026 exam period. Always requires formal supporting documentation for Academic Consideration.
